description.value: Fusion Feast is a family-owned fast-food restaurant in Lansdowne Mall in Richmond, serving a creative mashup of pizza and Indian cuisine — think Butter Chicken pizza, Palak Paneer, and samosas alongside more familiar pies. The kitchen also runs catering and hot lunch programs for local schools and businesses. A touring cyclist stopping in Richmond will find a broad, filling menu with both vegetarian and meat options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an active business at 5300 No 3 Road, Richmond (Lansdowne Mall) with phone (604) 370-9422 and email info@fusionfeast.ca. The menu explicitly lists vegetarian options (Fusion Veggie pizza, Palak Paneer, Chana Masala, Samosa), and the catering page states they 'can accommodate many dietary restrictions and allergies.' No information about bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record is missing address and phone fields; both are present on the website (5300 No 3 Road, Richmond; (604) 370-9422).
Website copyright reads '© Fusion Feast 2021' — site may not have been updated recently, though content appears active and business shows no signs of closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food restaurant confirmed via working website and consistent contact details; a useful food stop for cyclists in Richmond.
enrichment_extras.notes: Located inside Lansdowne Mall; mall washrooms and potential bike parking infrastructure may be nearby but are not confirmed from available evidence.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian options including Fusion Veggie pizza, Palak Paneer, Chana Masala, and Samosa. Catering page states they 'can accommodate many dietary restrictions and allergies.'
